commit.message:
profile: Series-A overhaul — fix broken links, verified counts, v11 DOI table, add Lean kernel (#21)

- Remove broken references to szl-sdk, trust, engineering, rosie (none of these repos exist)
- Replace SDK pillar with Lean Proofs ([lutar-lean]) — the kernel-verified companion to the runtime
- Refresh Trust pillar to point at actual repo: szl-trust (was: trust)
- Add Cookbook + Brand pillars (szl-cookbook, szl-brand)
- Runtime test count: 172/172 → 218/218 (verified 2026-05-12 against ouroboros f31d749)
- Add platform metrics: 1,220 tests · 76 packages · MCP gateway 27/27 e2e (verified 2026-05-12 via full-sweep-2b)
- Thesis-publications table: extend through v11 (current published, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20119582) and v12 in review (PR #25)
- Remove ROSIE from surfaces diagram (does not exist as a separate repo) — 8 surfaces → 7 surfaces, agreeing with the rest of the org
- Hero badge row: add Lean 4 kernel-verified, remove SDK, fix Trust → szl-trust

Co-authored-by: Stephen P. Lutar Jr. <stephen@szlholdings.com>
